decisions.reason: The original Definition step 2 leaves rounded dot-product parenthesization unspecified. In precision p=3 with a sufficiently wide normal exponent range, fl(fl(16+2)+2)=16 whereas fl(16+fl(2+2))=20 under ties-to-even. Thus this is an incomplete operational definition, classified as other rather than an erroneous proof inference or missing citation. The repair fixes every row and inner-index order, rounds multiplication, addition, subtraction and division separately, forbids fusion/reassociation, and returns the first failure with its full solve location.

reviews.reason: Checked the arithmetic model, called Cholesky procedure, exact substitution recursions and exact reference-solve theorem. The exact reference equation and absence of a computed-solve error guarantee are preserved. This is a repair review, not independent review of the newly written instructions.
